why_it_moved.text: The scorecard has no segment cuts, so the mechanism behind the small lift in Successful Search Rate is not known.
why_it_moved.label: guess

would_change: More users, with Successful Search Rate still near +0.12%, would show the 0.50% bar is out of reach and end the test with no win.
If the extended data puts the whole range of Successful Search Rate above 0.50%, with every guardrail still inside its margin, the bar is met.
A pre-exposure comparison and a daily series by days since first exposure would settle the two checks that could not run.
